item.title: Staff Post: Licensing/Images - OPEN
item.content:encoded:
It has been brought to the Licensing Team's attention that the images on this article are clearly copyrighted and not compatible with our license. The images have been removed from display until a full investigation can take place, at which time licensing will either delete or replace the images as we can manage. At least one image can be found here, and it's not the one with a clear copyright watermark. I will do the legwork at some point today to find the rest.

If you wish to submit appropriate CC-by-SA-3.0 compatible images for consideration as a replacement, please either comment here or contact a member of the licensing team.

item.title: A comment
item.content:encoded:
You mean as in, the Bright List? That thing got bloated over time and what is there still is stuff that the author formerly known as Bright (he now goes by The Duckman) considers acceptable or at least has enough nostalgia baggage to remain there. He has disowned the "wacky Dr. Bright" characterization, mostly.

There's really nothing stopping you from attempting to write your own humourous tale about someone trying to steal this and doing weird things with it, but trying to use the Bright character will generate some instant friction from certain users, whereas others will give it a shot but will likely comment that adding Bright was likely gratuituous.
